title: LTEM table model
description: A parsed LTEM table, as defined by the LTEM specification version 1.0. See table-model.md for field meanings and the rules that JSON Schema cannot express.

rows.description: Number of grid rows: header rows followed by body rows.

cols.description: Number of grid columns, equal to the number of cells in the delimiter row.

header_rows.description: Number of header rows. Rows 0 to header_rows - 1 are header rows.

align.description: Alignment of each column, from the delimiter row. Its length equals cols.

cells.description: One entry per cell, sorted by row and then by column. Together the cells cover every grid position exactly once.

row.description: Row of the cell's origin (top-left position), counting from 0.

col.description: Column of the cell's origin, counting from 0.

rowspan.description: Number of rows the cell spans.

colspan.description: Number of columns the cell spans.

text.description: Inline Markdown source of the cell. Lines are separated by a line feed (U+000A).
